prompts.ice: Use case: stylized-concept. Game transparent enemy sprite sheet. Reference image defines EXACT pose layout, right facing, squat hulking proportions, position and scale in every cell. Create a 3 columns by 4 rows sheet of an ICE TROLL replacing the reference troll. Painted slightly photoreal game illustration, friendly grumpy-silly face, broad nose, two arms only. Made entirely of frosty blue-white ice and packed snow, icicle hair and beard, shoulder frost, lumpy snowdrift belly, chunky crystal fingers/toes. Row1 three subtle idle sway poses. Row2 three walking poses. Row3 grab lunge BOTH empty hands out ahead; lift BOTH empty hands overhead; throw arms thrust forward. Row4 falling backward head LEFT; collapsing into fractured ice; final low heap of broken ice and snow WITH his icicle-bearded head resting on top. Keep all twelve clearly separated within equal square cells, full silhouettes with margins. No cell lines, text, ground, shadows, flying debris outside silhouette, or dolls. Genuine transparent background. Match reference poses closely, but final heap must be broken ice not sleeping intact body.
prompts.snow: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game sprite source sheet, FOUR equal square cells in a 2 by 2 grid, read left-right then top-bottom. Same cheeky running snowman in all four cells, facing RIGHT. Painted polished slightly realistic storybook game art with softly detailed snow, like collectible doll game assets. Three snowballs: large bottom, medium torso, head; coal eyes and happy cheeky coal smile, carrot nose, black little top hat, red-and-white striped scarf trailing LEFT, two twig arms, two short stubby twig feet. Four distinct successive RUN CYCLE phases: left foot forward right back; passing feet; right foot forward left back; opposite passing feet. Alternate twig arm swings, slight snowball squash and bounce, scarf flap. Exactly same snowman anatomy and scale all cells, head-to-feet about 80% cell height, ample margins, complete silhouettes. Genuine alpha transparent background. No cast shadow, loose snowflakes, ground, text, frames or extra characters.
prompts.icon: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is a game power-up sheet with five icons. Generate just ONE replacement icon in its same glossy painted toy icon style: a cheeky snowman's head with black top hat, carrot nose and coal eyes/smile, red-and-white striped scarf visible, peeking up out of a small compact snowdrift. This is the new snowman EMP button icon, replaces the lightning-cloud airhorn. Three-quarter-ish frontal icon, centered complete subject with generous transparent margins, no platform/button base, no text, no lightning, no cast shadow. Match bright saturated outlined dimensional style of reference. Genuine transparent background.
prompts.snowCorrection: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this snowman source sheet, retaining the exact same snowman, materials, hat, red-white scarf, proportions and four successive running poses. CORRECT THE LAYOUT ONLY: four isolated complete snowmen in an EXACT 2x2 grid on a SQUARE transparent canvas. Each equal square cell must have at least 12% EMPTY transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. Shrink each snowman within its cell so absolutely nothing touches canvas or cell boundaries, including top hat, scarf tips, twig fingertips and twig feet. Preserve four distinct successive running poses with opposite stride in frames1 and3, passing feet2 and4. Genuine alpha. No ground, shadows, text, cell outlines, snow particles or new objects. Ensure ALL FOUR hats and ALL EIGHT feet are fully visible.
